candidates.change_summary: Change the require to require that the incoming value is non-zero, preventing zero-value Put calls from increasing balance or updating unlockTime.
Remove the safety require that checked overflow and instead unconditionally add msg.value to balance (note: in 0.8.0 this will still revert on overflow but semantics differ from original require).
Set unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime unconditionally, even if it is earlier than current block.timestamp, allowing earlier unlocks.
Replace assignment to unlockTime with setting it to block.timestamp (ignoring provided _unlockTime), so unlockTime always becomes now on Put.
Insert clearing of previous balance before adding msg.value, causing balance to be set to only msg.value (not cumulative).
Change the transfer method from call to send (limiting gas and returning only bool) which can cause different success/failure behavior and thus change resulting balances and emitted logs.
Remove the decrement of acc.balance before attempting the external call so a failed external transfer leaves balance intact (changing observable post-Collect balance).
Change the condition to require block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime (allowing collect at exact unlockTime) which alters when Collect can succeed and thus observed balances after call.
Replace the conditional guard acc.balance>=MinSum with a stricter acc.balance>MinSum (disallowing equals), changing whether Collect proceeds and thus post-call balance.
Invert the comparison acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance<=_am so Collect proceeds only when balance is less-or-equal to requested amount, changing whether and how balances update.
